title: FloodPay Underwriting Acceptance Limits
content:
The acceptance limits of FloodPay Parametric Flood Cover (Surplus Lines) fix, for each tier, the kind of customer the tier serves, the occupancies it accepts, how high above the base flood elevation the location's lowest floor may stand, how many policies may sit on one location, the named storm binding restriction, and whether the cover can satisfy a lender's flood insurance requirement.

## Acceptance table

| Tier | Customer the tier serves | Occupancies accepted | Highest accepted lowest-floor height above base flood elevation (whole feet) | Policies allowed on one location | No binding within this many hours before a named storm's forecast landfall (elapsed hours) | Can satisfy a lender's flood insurance requirement |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| FloodPay Home 5K | Individual | Single-family home; condominium unit; rented residence | 3 | 1 | 72 | No |
| FloodPay Home 10K | Individual | Single-family home; condominium unit; rented residence | 3 | 1 | 72 | No |
| FloodPay Home 25K | Individual | Single-family home; condominium unit | 3 | 1 | 72 | No |
| FloodPay Business 50K | Business | Retail; office; restaurant; warehouse | 3 | 1 | 72 | No |
| FloodPay Business 100K | Business | Retail; office; restaurant; warehouse | 3 | 1 | 72 | No |
| FloodPay Business 250K | Business | Retail; office; restaurant; warehouse; light industrial | 5 | 1 | 72 | No |

## Points of distinction between tiers

- **Customer type.** FloodPay Home 5K, 10K and 25K serve individual customers; FloodPay Business 50K, 100K and 250K serve business customers.
- **Occupancy.** A rented residence is accepted on FloodPay Home 5K and FloodPay Home 10K but is not among the occupancies of FloodPay Home 25K, which accepts single-family homes and condominium units. Light industrial premises are accepted only on FloodPay Business 250K; the other Business tiers accept retail, office, restaurant and warehouse premises.
- **Elevation band.** The lowest floor may stand no more than 3 whole feet above the base flood elevation on every tier except FloodPay Business 250K, where the limit is 5 whole feet.
- **Policies per location.** 1 policy per location on every tier.
- **Named storm restriction.** On every tier the restriction runs 72 elapsed hours before a named storm's forecast landfall.
- **Lender requirement.** On no tier can FloodPay satisfy a lender's flood insurance requirement.

## Worked reading of the elevation band (hypothetical locations)

The band is stated in whole feet of lowest-floor height above the base flood elevation, and the limit is "no more than" the figure, so the figure itself is inside the band.

| Hypothetical location | Tier | Lowest floor above base flood elevation | Within the tier's band |
|---|---|---|---|
| Location P | FloodPay Home 10K | 3 whole feet | Yes — equal to the limit of 3 |
| Location Q | FloodPay Home 10K | 4 whole feet | No — above the limit of 3 |
| Location R | FloodPay Business 250K | 5 whole feet | Yes — equal to the limit of 5 |
| Location S | FloodPay Business 250K | 6 whole feet | No — above the limit of 5 |
